global.comment: single_country_max_frac: flag only pathological single-country skew (>~8/12) — real P3 papers reach 8/12 France. blend_frac_min: ~29% of real wines are blends; flag a paper with almost none. suite_curveball_total: ~9 medium+high wines across the 36-wine suite, P3-weighted. ow_frac_min floors are set to the OBSERVED historical minima (P1 4:8, P2 5:7, P3 6:6) — EK-0099's 'never NW-majority' holds ONLY for P3; P1 and P2 each had a NW-majority paper in 2015-2025, so never_nw_majority is enforced on P3 only.
